mentions.name: Photogenesis
mentions.description: This iOS and Android app applies generative art effects to users' photos, turning them into creative animated works of art. It uses techniques like circle packing, line walkers, mosaic grids, marching squares, voronoi tessellation, glitch art, string art, and perlin flow fields, and runs fully offline with no AI, subscriptions, or ads.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's an iOS & Android app that applies various generative art effects to your photos, letting you turn your photos into creative animated works of art. It's fully offline, no AI, no subscriptions, no ads, etc.
